findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation for document reads
findings.body: When the user and document belong to different tenants, `canReadDocument` now returns `true` unconditionally. Consumers relying on this authorization function will therefore permit cross-tenant document access, bypassing the previous tenant boundary.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now permits every read. When `userTenant !== documentTenant`, a user can access another tenant’s documents, creating a cross-tenant authorization bypass and data exposure.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in the document-read authorization check
findings.body:
`canReadDocument("tenant-a", "tenant-b")` now returns `true`, allowing any consumer of this exported authorization function to grant cross-tenant document access. This is a complete bypass of the prior tenant-boundary enforcement.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
